    minimum' as = foldl1 f $ assocs as

        f (i,x) (j,y)

          | y <= 0 = (i,x)
          | x > y = (j,y)
          | otherwise = (i,x)

      if x > 0 then
        solve' (as // [(j, y - 1)]) (cs // [(i, (cs ! i) + 1)])
      else
        cs
      where
        (i,x) = maximum' as
        (j,y) = minimum' as
